text:
Avery: quick pass on Keys card in Compliance — spotted a few micro nits while doing QA on the console. can we discuss?
Ben: sure, what did you see?
Avery: a few areas: 1) key "badge" area is dense — the ARN, key-state pill, and KMS badge are all inline and it wraps weirdly; 2) audit timeline timestamps are full iso w/ timezone offset which is noisy; 3) keyboard focus order puts the copy-ARN button after the expand, makes keyboard users hit extra keystrokes; 4) region group label sits visually far from the encryption toggle, causing association confusion.
Sofia: +1 on timestamp noise. current looks like `2026-07-15T13:04:22-07:00`. propose `13:04 UTC` or `13:04 PDT` depending on user locale, with a hover to reveal full ISO only in details.
Ben: for the badge density, maybe collapse to two lines: line1 = `Customer key • Active` (headline), line2 = `key-1a2b…` + small KMS icon. full ARN only in details. keeps scanning tight.
Avery: exact copy suggestion: headline `Customer key (CMK) — Active` muted line `key-1a2b…` and a tiny KMS glyph. clicking headline expands details with full ARN, created-by, and rotation history.
Sofia: keyboard flow: reorder so actions are: expand (chevron) -> copy id -> more actions. that keeps copy reachable without expanding for quick ops. set tabindex accordingly.
Ben: also accessibility nit: KMS badge contrast is borderline on the current background — need to bump to AA. I'll add color token suggestions in the PR.
Avery: region + toggle placement: on narrow view group them under a single label `Region & Encryption` so they're perceived as a single setting; alternatively visually nest the toggle under the region selector with a subtle divider.
Sofia: audit timeline verbs: switch to past tense (e.g., `Key rotated`, `Key accessed by <actor>`) and show the short key id in parentheses. avoids the giant ARNs inline.
Ben: small copy tweak for retention link text: from `Set retention` -> `Edit retention period` (clearer CTA for inline edit flows).
Avery: final action items: 1) compact headline + muted id line, 2) show short timestamp + expand for ISO, 3) reorder keyboard focus to reduce keystrokes, 4) group region/toggle on small widths, 5) bump badge contrast to AA, 6) change retention CTA to `Edit retention period`.
Sofia: i'll mock the focus order and timestamp dropdown in figma and attach frames.
Ben: i'll open a tiny PR for color + copy + tabindex notes. tagging @a11y for a11y sign-off.
design-bot: note created — DESIGN-1221: "Compact key headline + timeline tz + focus order" (owner: Ben).
infra-bot: automated note — INF-8486 created: "Keys card UX & a11y micro-nits" (priority: P3).
Avery: thanks team, appreciate quick reviews :raised_hands:
note: Slack-thread style JSON for product channel; includes root and replies.
